groups.why: Both rows check that the DB objects SCMP_APP uses (PKG, tables/views, synonyms, privileges) and the menu, PROC_M and SHEET_COLUMNS metadata exist and are VALID. Both expect a missing or broken object to stop the test and show up under 'action needed' item 1 instead of as a defect.
This row runs a static check on PKG_SSP0014 for TB_FX_* references and a valid ATTRIBUTE9 combo SQL_ID. No other row checks both of these on the same package.

This row checks TB_FX_* user-table references in other packages (PKG_DMF0003 and others) and also expects the SCM_ADM_* tables to be used. Its target and expected result differ from the PKG_SSP0014 check.
This trace row only follows the separate SP PKG_SSP0014.P_SSP0014_GET_USER_ID_CHECK (row 3 of the comparison sheet), so no other row has the same target.
This trace row only follows the separate SP PKG_SCM0002.P_SCM0002_GET_ITEM_BY_DIVISION_POPUP (row 1 of the comparison sheet).
This trace row follows the ProgressForm(FindData/SaveData) row element, which is a different element type from the SP trace rows.
This trace row only follows the lookup SP SSP0014_GET_SHIPMENT_MODEL_PIC (row 4 of the comparison sheet).
This trace row only follows the save SP SSP0014_SAVE_SHIPMENT_MODEL_PIC (row 2 of the comparison sheet), which is a different object from the lookup SP.
